round2.summary: I reloaded all 84 induction lanes from raw YAML and independently reproduced every number in EXTENS_VS_NOISE_REPORT.txt and in round-1's perm.out. perm.py has no bug, and studentizing is a provable no-op (Sum d_s^2 is flip-invariant), so the exact seed-level sign-flip is the best member of the cluster-permutation family -- and it is the repo's own documented recommendation (MULTIPLICITY_PLAN.md:286) that the published 210-family inference never applied. Round 1's INVALID_METHOD finding is CONFIRMED and strengthened: a new permutation test rejects item-level exchangeability for glm_47 at p=2.0e-04, and its noise arm collapses on 7 of 30 seeds which supply +33 of the +27 net margin. Round 1's "true p lies between 2.44e-03 and 5.19e-02" is MODIFIED; three cluster methods land at 0.034-0.052. Two new major defects: Holm(210) falls from 125 to 119 under cluster p (all six losses are ladder contrasts), and the doc's "strongest lane just below the line points the other way" is false -- glm_47 is 8th of 13 clean lanes, behind two noise-higher lanes. The section-1.1 headline survives intact: 10 of 21, identical set, clean-5 unanimous with worst cluster p 8.345e-07.

rulings.finding: ROUND-1 METHOD QUESTION: is collapsing to seed sums throwing away within-seed information that a finer valid test could keep?
rulings.evidence: No. (i) T = sum_s d_s equals b-c exactly, so no point-estimate information is lost -- only the null variance changes (b+c -> sum d_s^2). (ii) Every cluster-sign-flip statistic reduces to a sign-flip on weighted seed sums, since flipping seed s flips all 9 of its item differences. (iii) Studentising is a provable no-op: sum d_s^2 and the within-seed discordance count are both flip-invariant, so paired-t is monotone in |sum d_s| -- verified, all 21 p-values identical (table.py). (iv) CMH stratified by harmonic is NOT cluster-respecting: its variance is still item-level (paired_analysis.py:163-179).
rulings.revised: The unweighted exact seed-level sign-flip is the best defensible member of the family. Triangulated with a 200k cluster bootstrap over seeds and a paired t on the 30 seed differences; all three agree on every ruling.
